ch1.title: The Crossing
ch1.subtitle: One season at the ferry
ch1.epigraph: Whoever keeps the ferry keeps the road.

mended_boat.description: The boat was mended before the first crossing

told_reeve.description: Told the reeve the truth about the rope

carried_friar.description: Carried the friar across in the flood

took_bribe.description: Took the wool-man's coin to cross first

aldith.name: Aldith Reeve
aldith.title: Mistress
aldith.notes: The village reeve. Gave you the ferry.

osric.name: Brother Osric
osric.notes: A friar on the road south.

cracked_ribs.label: Cracked ribs
cracked_ribs.description: Every stroke of the oar hurts.

good_pole.label: A good pole
good_pole.description: Ash, iron-shod. Worth a point of boatcraft in a current.

kept.label: The ferry kept
kept.description: You kept the crossing through the season and the village knows it.

lost.label: The ferry lost
lost.description: The reeve gave the ferry to someone else.

c_first_morning.title: The first morning
c_first_morning.text:
The river is up a hand's breadth since yesterday, brown and quick at the edges.
[if start == heir]Your father's boat is where he left it, and so is his pole, and so is the rope he always meant to replace.[else]The boat they gave you is older than you are, and the rope is older than the boat.[/if]
[break]
The first knock on the landing comes before the light does. {name}, says a voice. Is the ferry running or not?

variants.stranger:
Nobody in the village has said your name yet. They call you the ferry, as if you were the boat.
[break]
The first knock on the landing comes before the light does. Is the ferry running or not?

choices.text: Mend the boat before you take anyone across.
choices.text_after: The caulking takes the morning. The first passengers wait on the bank and watch you do it properly.

choices.text: Take the first fare now and mend it later.
choices.text_after: Six pence, and the boat takes water at the seam all the way over.

choices.text: Go up to the reeve's house and ask what she expects of you.
choices.text_after: Aldith hears you out at her door. "Run it every day the river lets you," she says. "And tell me the truth when it does not."

effects.journal: Asked Mistress Aldith what the ferry owes the village.

c_flood.title: High water
c_flood.text: By noon the river is over the lower step. A friar in a grey habit is on the far bank, waving, and behind you a wool-man with a cart is offering money to go first.

choices.text: Cross for the friar now, flood or not.
choices.warn: The river is in flood. A bad crossing can drown you.

success.text: You come in on the bend the way your hands remember, and the friar steps off dry-shod. "Brother Osric," he says. "I will remember this ferry."

partial.text: The current turns the boat broadside and slams you into the post. You get him over. Your ribs will tell you about it for weeks.

failure.text: The rope parts at the second bend.

effects.die: The river took you at the second bend, in the spring flood.

choices.text: Wait for the water to drop, and let him wait too.
choices.text_after: The friar sits down on the far bank to wait. He does not look pleased.

choices.text: Take the wool-man's coin and carry his cart over first.
choices.text_after: Twenty pence, and the friar watches you take it.

c_reckoning.title: Michaelmas
c_reckoning.text:
By Michaelmas the ferry has taken {takings} at the landing. Aldith comes down to the river to settle the year.
[if flag.took_bribe]She knows about the wool-man. Everyone does.[elif flag.carried_friar]Brother Osric has been telling the story of the flood in every village south of here.[else]She has heard about the friar who waited on the bank.[/if]

choices.text: Tell her exactly what the ferry did and did not do.
Tell her the ferry never missed a day.

e_kept.title: The ferry kept
e_kept.text: Aldith nods once. "Next year, then." It is the most anyone in the village has ever said to you about the ferry, and it is enough.

e_lost.title: The ferry lost
e_lost.text: Aldith gives the ferry to her cousin's boy at Candlemas. You watch him from the bank, taking water at the seam.

e_otter.title: The otter
e_otter.text: An otter surfaces beside the boat in the slack water, looks at you as if you owed it money, and is gone.

choices.text_after: It goes where the fish are. You remember the place.

e_quiet.title: A quiet day
e_quiet.text: Nobody comes to the landing all day. You sit in the boat and listen to the river.

q_friar_word.title: Word from the south
q_friar_word.text: A carter brings word that a grey friar has been telling the villages south of here about a ferry that would not cross.

choices.text: Shrug. The river was in flood.

heir.label: The ferryman's child
heir.summary: Your father kept this ferry for thirty years. His back has gone, and the village is watching to see what you are.

stranger.label: The stranger
stranger.summary: You came down the road in the winter with nothing, and the reeve gave you the ferry because nobody else would take it.
